objective: Define a format-neutral model source abstraction that probes local model inputs and selects a loader without reading tensor payloads.
mathematical_spec: Let S be an input source and F={GGUF,SAFETENSORS}. Define probe(S)->(f,c) with f in F union {UNKNOWN}, confidence c in [0,1], and require c=1 only when format magic/header invariants are satisfied. Selection must be deterministic for identical bytes and path metadata.
implementation_prompt: Implement the model source probe and loader-selection contract. Support single-file and sharded paths, return structured evidence for the selected format, avoid tensor payload reads during probing, and expose UNKNOWN for ambiguous or invalid inputs.

objective: Specify strict GGUF header parsing and version gating.
mathematical_spec: Parse H=(magic,version,n_tensors,n_kv). Require magic='GGUF', version in supported_versions, n_tensors>=0, n_kv>=0, and checked arithmetic for all subsequent offsets. Define header_end as the first byte after the fixed header fields for that version.
implementation_prompt: Implement a bounds-checked GGUF header parser with explicit supported-version policy, overflow-safe counts, and structured errors for bad magic, truncated headers, unsupported versions, and impossible counts.

objective: Project GGUF key-value metadata into a typed metadata table while preserving unknown keys.
mathematical_spec: For metadata entries e_i=(k_i,t_i,v_i), define M[k_i]=(t_i,v_i). Keys must be unique under the GGUF key namespace; known keys are decoded to typed values and unknown keys remain losslessly representable. Array lengths and byte spans must satisfy file bounds.
implementation_prompt: Implement typed GGUF metadata decoding with lossless preservation of unknown keys, duplicate-key detection, bounded arrays/strings, and lookup helpers that distinguish missing, malformed, and unsupported metadata.

objective: Parse the GGUF tensor directory into immutable tensor descriptors.
mathematical_spec: For tensor j define D_j=(name,dims,type,offset). Require rank>=1, dims_k>0, unique names, storage_size(D_j)>=0, and data_base+offset+storage_size<=file_size. The directory parse must not map or decode payloads.
implementation_prompt: Implement GGUF tensor-directory parsing that produces immutable descriptors, validates unique names/ranks/dimensions/types, computes storage spans with checked arithmetic, and never touches tensor payload bytes.

objective: Resolve split GGUF shard sets into one logical tensor namespace.
mathematical_spec: Let shards G_1..G_m expose split metadata (index,count,tensor_count). Require a complete index set {0..m-1}, consistent split count/model identity metadata, and globally unique tensor names. Logical directory D is the ordered union of shard directories.
implementation_prompt: Implement GGUF split-shard discovery and validation. Detect missing, duplicate, or foreign shards; preserve deterministic shard order; and expose one logical tensor catalog with source-shard ownership per tensor.

objective: Plan page-aligned mmap regions for GGUF tensor payloads.
mathematical_spec: For each tensor byte interval I_j=[a_j,b_j), map to page interval P_j=[floor(a_j/P)P,ceil(b_j/P)P). Coalesce P_j,P_k only when policy allows and their gap <= G. Total mapped span must remain within file bounds.
implementation_prompt: Implement a GGUF mmap-region planner that converts tensor spans to page-aligned regions, supports deterministic coalescing, records intra-map offsets, and rejects any region that exceeds its backing shard.

objective: Specify strict Safetensors header and tensor descriptor parsing.
mathematical_spec: Read 8-byte little-endian header length L, then JSON J of exactly L bytes. For tensor t, descriptor=(dtype,shape,[o0,o1)). Require 0<=o0<=o1<=payload_size, product(shape)*dtype_size=o1-o0 for dense supported dtypes, and no overlapping tensor ranges.
implementation_prompt: Implement a bounded Safetensors parser that validates header length, JSON structure, dtype/shape/offset fields, dense byte-size equality, unique tensor names, and non-overlapping payload ranges.

objective: Resolve Safetensors index JSON and shards into a single logical tensor directory.
mathematical_spec: Let weight_map map tensor name -> shard file. Require every referenced shard exists, every requested tensor occurs exactly once in its referenced shard, and no shard tensor conflicts with the index. Logical order is stable lexicographic tensor-name order unless source order is explicitly required.
implementation_prompt: Implement Safetensors index/shard resolution for model.safetensors.index.json style layouts, with deterministic ordering, missing-shard detection, index-to-file consistency checks, and source ownership on descriptors.

objective: Normalize raw GGUF and Safetensors metadata into a common typed model metadata view.
mathematical_spec: Define N_f:R_f->C where C contains architecture, dimensions, vocab facts, positional encoding, quantization hints, and provenance. For any field x, normalized value must retain source key and confidence/origin; absent values remain absent rather than defaulted silently.
implementation_prompt: Implement the common metadata projection layer. Map format-specific keys into typed canonical fields, retain provenance for every normalized value, preserve unknown metadata, and keep missing distinct from inferred/defaulted.

objective: Normalize architecture configuration required by the tree runtime.
mathematical_spec: Define canonical config C=(L,H,H_kv,D,D_ff,V,rope,eps,...). Enforce D mod H=0, H_kv>0, H mod H_kv=0 where grouped-query attention requires it, L>0, V>0, and architecture-specific constraints as named predicates.
implementation_prompt: Implement architecture-config normalization and validation for supported decoder families. Produce a canonical immutable config plus explicit architecture-specific validation failures; do not invent missing critical dimensions.

objective: Normalize vocabulary and tokenizer metadata needed to bind draft and target models.
mathematical_spec: Define tokenizer signature T=(tokenizer_family,V,special_token_map,vocab_hash,merge_or_model_hash). Equality for exact sharing requires all signature fields compatible; partial compatibility must be represented explicitly.
implementation_prompt: Implement tokenizer/vocabulary metadata normalization sufficient for loader-time compatibility checks. Compute stable signatures from available metadata and expose exact, partial, or incompatible status without loading runtime tokenizer code.

objective: Map format-specific tensor names to canonical semantic tensor roles.
mathematical_spec: Define canonicalization C(name,arch)->(role,layer,expert,subrole) or UNKNOWN. C must be deterministic and injective over all known required tensors for a model instance; aliases may map only when source descriptors are mutually exclusive.
implementation_prompt: Implement an architecture-aware tensor-name canonicalizer with explicit alias tables, layer/expert index extraction, collision detection, and UNKNOWN passthrough for unrecognized tensors.

objective: Validate tensor shapes against canonical architecture roles.
mathematical_spec: For each role r define expected shape set E_r(C). A descriptor d is valid iff shape(d) in E_r(C), allowing only documented transpose/layout alternatives. Report expected and observed symbolic dimensions on failure.
implementation_prompt: Implement role-based tensor shape validation for embeddings, attention, MLP, norms, output heads, and supported architecture variants. Keep accepted layout alternatives explicit and reject silent reshaping.

objective: Represent logical tensor layout independently from storage encoding.
mathematical_spec: Define layout descriptor L=(logical_axes,storage_axes,permutation,block_shape,strides_if_dense). Applying permutation to storage axes must recover logical axes; block_shape must divide or validly tail-cover the encoded dimensions according to quant type.
implementation_prompt: Implement canonical tensor layout descriptors that separate semantic axes from on-disk order. Cover dense, transposed, blocked-quantized, fused-QKV, and expert-packed cases needed by loader planning.

objective: Define zero-copy tensor storage views over mapped or buffered model bytes.
mathematical_spec: A storage view V=(owner,base_offset,length,alignment,readonly). Any tensor slice [o,o+n) requires 0<=o and o+n<=length. View lifetime must not exceed owner lifetime, and mutable access is forbidden for readonly model storage.
implementation_prompt: Implement the storage-view contract for mmap and buffered sources, including owner lifetime pinning, slice bounds checks, alignment reporting, and zero-copy subviews used by tensor materialization.

objective: Validate byte order, alignment, and encoded tensor span invariants before materialization.
mathematical_spec: For each descriptor require supported endian convention, offset mod required_alignment(type)=0 when mandated by the format/kernel, and encoded_span(type,shape)=declared_span. Misalignment may be recoverable only through an explicit copy fallback.
implementation_prompt: Implement pre-materialization storage validation for endian assumptions, alignment, span sizing, and quant block boundaries. Return a recoverable misalignment result only when a copy-based fallback is legal.

objective: Specify mmap ownership, eviction, and lifetime semantics for model loading.
mathematical_spec: Let mappings M form owners of views V. Invariant: refcount(M)>0 for every live V backed by M. Closing a loader decrements only loader-owned references; mappings are released when no model/tensor view retains them.
implementation_prompt: Implement mmap lifetime policy objects with explicit ownership transfer to loaded model handles, deterministic cleanup, and safe coexistence of multiple tensors sharing the same mapped region.

objective: Define buffered read fallback when mmap is unavailable or unsuitable.
mathematical_spec: For requested intervals I, construct buffers B such that bytes(B_i)=bytes(source[I_i]) exactly. Fallback selection is triggered by capability/policy errors, never by data-integrity errors. Buffer alignment must satisfy downstream kernel requirements.
implementation_prompt: Implement buffered payload loading as the mmap fallback. Preserve exact bytes, allocate required alignment, coalesce reads when safe, and distinguish environment mmap failures from corrupt model data.

objective: Provide optional tensor-byte integrity verification with deterministic hashes.
mathematical_spec: For tensor byte span X define h=Hash(X) using a configured stable algorithm. Verification result is VERIFIED only if expected hash exists and equals h, UNVERIFIED if no reference exists, and FAILED on mismatch; FAILED must never fall back to another decoder.
implementation_prompt: Implement optional per-tensor and/or per-shard integrity verification hooks with streaming hashes, provenance of expected digests, and strict mismatch handling separate from unsupported-format fallback.

objective: Define loader error taxonomy and legal fallback transitions.
mathematical_spec: Partition errors into CORRUPT, UNSUPPORTED, RESOURCE, POLICY, INTERNAL. A fallback edge A->B is legal only for UNSUPPORTED/RESOURCE/POLICY cases declared recoverable. CORRUPT and INTERNAL are terminal. Preserve the causal chain across attempts.
implementation_prompt: Implement structured loader errors plus a fallback-decision function. Encode terminal versus recoverable categories, retain source locations/causes, and prevent corrupt model bytes from being masked by alternate loaders.

objective: Create a quantization type registry shared by format loaders and kernels.
mathematical_spec: For quant type q define Q_q=(id,block_elems,block_bytes,scale_type,zero_type,packing,logical_dtype). Require unique ids/names and density bits_per_weight=8*block_bytes/block_elems for fixed-size block formats.
implementation_prompt: Implement a registry describing supported dense and quantized encodings, including GGML/GGUF families plus adapter encodings needed for GPTQ, AWQ, and bitsandbytes. Expose block sizing and kernel capability keys.

objective: Decode GGML/GGUF quantized block boundaries without dequantizing weights.
mathematical_spec: For tensor with N logical elements and block size B, require N compatible with the quant scheme's block/tail rule and encoded bytes equal blocks(N,q)*block_bytes(q). Block iterator maps logical ranges to exact encoded byte ranges.
implementation_prompt: Implement quant-block span calculation and iteration for registered GGML/GGUF quant types. Validate encoded sizes and expose block metadata without converting weights to floating point.

objective: Define a common dequantization contract for all registered quant encodings.
mathematical_spec: For encoded block z and quant parameters theta, D_q(z,theta)->x in R^B. Define reference error metric e=max_i |x_i-x_ref_i| and dtype-specific tolerance tau_q; conformance requires e<=tau_q against a trusted reference decoder.
implementation_prompt: Implement the dequantization interface and CPU reference path for registered encodings, with explicit output dtype, block/tail handling, and hooks for numerical conformance testing against trusted references.

objective: Plan dequantization on the fly without materializing full floating-point weights.
mathematical_spec: For matmul Y=XW, partition W into encoded tiles W_q^k. Compute Y=sum_k X_k D_q(W_q^k) while peak temporary dequant bytes <= budget B_tmp. Tile order must preserve deterministic accumulation mode when requested.
implementation_prompt: Implement a tile planner for dequant-on-the-fly matmul. Choose encoded tile spans, temporary output dtype, and workspace under a byte budget, while exposing deterministic and throughput-oriented accumulation modes.

objective: Dispatch quantized matrix multiplication to native or dequantized kernels.
mathematical_spec: Define capability predicate K(device,q,M,N,K,layout). If true select native quant matmul; else select dequant-on-the-fly when D_q exists and workspace fits; else mark unsupported. Dispatch must preserve numerical contract and logical layout.
implementation_prompt: Implement quantized matmul dispatch planning from tensor encoding, device capability, dimensions, and layout. Prefer native registered kernels, then legal dequant-on-the-fly fallback, and return a structured unsupported result otherwise.

objective: Specify mixed-precision tensor routing across dense and quantized model components.
mathematical_spec: For tensor role r assign compute dtype c_r and accumulation dtype a_r from policy P subject to kernel support and minimum precision constraints for sensitive roles. The plan must be deterministic for a fixed device capability set and policy.
implementation_prompt: Implement mixed-precision planning for embeddings, attention/MLP weights, norms, output head, and auxiliary tree tensors. Validate requested compute/accumulation dtypes against available kernels and explicit precision policy.

objective: Parse GPTQ quantization metadata into a canonical quant descriptor.
mathematical_spec: Canonical GPTQ descriptor G=(bits,group_size,sym,desc_act,damp_percent?,packing_version). Require bits in supported set, group_size positive or documented per-channel sentinel, and metadata consistency across all GPTQ tensors.
implementation_prompt: Implement GPTQ metadata recognition from Safetensors/config-side metadata available to the loader contract, normalize it into a canonical descriptor, and reject ambiguous or internally inconsistent GPTQ configurations.

objective: Adapt GPTQ packed qweight/qzeros/scales tensors to canonical logical weight views.
mathematical_spec: Given bit width b, packed integer word width w, unpack factor p=w/b when divisible. Define logical weight reconstruction from qweight, qzeros, scales by group. Validate packed dimensions, scale groups, and zero-point cardinality before exposing the adapter.
implementation_prompt: Specify and implement the GPTQ packed-tensor adapter that binds qweight, qzeros, scales, and optional g_idx to one canonical logical tensor, with strict dimension/group validation and no eager full dequantization.

objective: Parse AWQ quantization metadata into a canonical quant descriptor.
mathematical_spec: Canonical AWQ descriptor A=(bits,group_size,zero_point,packing_version). Require supported bits, positive group_size, and a consistent descriptor for tensors participating in one quantized linear layer.
implementation_prompt: Implement AWQ metadata recognition and canonicalization, including version/packing markers when present. Reject mixed incompatible AWQ descriptors inside a single logical layer.

objective: Adapt AWQ packed weights, zeros, and scales into canonical logical weight views.
mathematical_spec: For group g reconstruct w_i=s_g*(q_i-z_g) under the declared AWQ packing order. Packed dimensions and group counts must map exactly to the canonical [out,in] logical matrix after any documented transpose/permutation.
implementation_prompt: Specify and implement an AWQ packed-tensor adapter with packing-order normalization, shape/group checks, and a lazy logical view usable by native quant kernels or dequant-on-the-fly fallback.

objective: Represent bitsandbytes 8-bit linear weights and quantization state in the loader contract.
mathematical_spec: Define B8=(W_i8,scale_state,outlier_state?). Logical reconstruction must match the declared bitsandbytes scheme, and auxiliary state dimensions must align with the logical matrix axes. Unsupported serialized runtime-only state is rejected explicitly.
implementation_prompt: Implement loader-side recognition and canonical descriptors for serializable bitsandbytes 8-bit weight/state layouts. Validate required auxiliary tensors and expose a lazy quant view without depending on the Python runtime.

objective: Represent bitsandbytes NF4/FP4 blockwise weights and quantization state.
mathematical_spec: For block size B, codebook C, indices q_i, and absmax a_g, reconstruct w_i=a_g*C[q_i] under the exact format normalization rule. Nested/double quant state, when present, must be represented recursively with bounded depth.
implementation_prompt: Implement canonical loader descriptors for bitsandbytes NF4 and FP4 blockwise tensors, including absmax/codebook state and supported nested quantization metadata, with strict block-count validation.

objective: Canonicalize scale and zero-point orientation across quant formats.
mathematical_spec: For a logical matrix W[out,in], define group axis, group size g, scales S and zeros Z in canonical orientation. Adapters provide transforms T_f such that T_f(S_f,Z_f)=(S,Z) without changing reconstructed W.
implementation_prompt: Implement scale/zero canonicalization helpers that normalize GPTQ, AWQ, bitsandbytes, and registered GGML-style metadata into explicit logical axes and group indexing.

objective: Validate quantization group-size compatibility with tensor shapes and kernels.
mathematical_spec: For quantized axis length K and group size g, require either K mod g=0 or a format-declared tail-group rule. Kernel eligibility additionally requires g in supported_group_sizes(device,q). Tail groups must route only to kernels that declare support.
implementation_prompt: Implement group-size and tail-group validation shared by quant adapters and kernel dispatch. Produce exact reasons when a model is decodable but lacks a native kernel for its grouping.

objective: Normalize GPTQ activation-order mappings into deterministic logical column order.
mathematical_spec: For desc_act GPTQ with g_idx vector, require len(g_idx)=K and every group id references an existing scale/zero group. Define permutation/reindex mapping P so logical column k uses quant group g_idx[k] while preserving original weight semantics.
implementation_prompt: Implement activation-order/g_idx validation and a canonical reindex descriptor for GPTQ. Avoid physically permuting full weights; expose metadata sufficient for compatible kernels or staged dequantization.

objective: Build a device and quantization kernel capability matrix.
mathematical_spec: Define C[d,q,op,layout,dtype,group]=supported plus constraints on alignment and dimensions. Capability lookup is pure for a frozen device descriptor and kernel registry. Unknown combinations resolve to unsupported, never guessed support.
implementation_prompt: Implement a capability matrix API populated from registered CPU/GPU kernels. Include quant type, operation, layout, compute dtype, group-size, alignment, and dimension constraints used by loader planning.

objective: Specify deterministic repacking from source quant layouts to native kernel layouts.
mathematical_spec: For source bytes X and repack transform R_{a->b}, require decode_b(R(X)) numerically equivalent to decode_a(X) within the quant format tolerance. Cache key includes source identity/hash, tensor span, source layout, target layout, and kernel ABI version.
implementation_prompt: Implement the repack-plan contract and cache-key definition for quant tensors that require kernel-native packing. Keep repacking explicit, versioned, reproducible, and independently invalidatable per tensor.

objective: Define bounded dequantized-weight fallback when no quant kernel or repack path is usable.
mathematical_spec: For selected tensor W_q, materialize W_f=D_q(W_q) only if bytes(W_f)<=remaining fallback budget and policy permits. Allocation dtype is explicit. Failure to fit budget returns RESOURCE without partial model mutation.
implementation_prompt: Implement a loader fallback plan that can materialize selected quantized tensors to a supported floating dtype under a strict memory budget, with transactional allocation and clear RESOURCE failure.

objective: Plan tensor residency across CPU memory and accelerator memory.
mathematical_spec: For tensors t with storage bytes s_t and candidate devices d, choose placement p(t) satisfying per-device memory budgets and required-op capability. Total resident bytes plus declared workspaces must fit each budget; placement records transfer requirements.
implementation_prompt: Implement a deterministic tensor residency planner using model tensor descriptors, quant kernel support, device memory budgets, and fallback workspace costs. Output placement plus required copies/maps, without performing transfers.

objective: Plan layer-wise placement while preserving cross-layer execution dependencies.
mathematical_spec: For layers l=0..L-1 assign device p_l. Transition cost includes activation transfer C(p_l,p_{l+1}); feasibility includes all layer tensors and workspaces. Respect user-fixed placements first, then deterministic policy for remaining layers.
implementation_prompt: Implement layer placement planning on top of tensor residency constraints, including fixed user assignments, accelerator offload ranges, transition-cost metadata, and validation that every layer has executable kernels.

objective: Define the tree-runtime loaded-model handle contract.
mathematical_spec: ModelHandle contains canonical config, tensor-role map, storage owners, placement plan, quant descriptors, kernel plans, and provenance. Invariant: every required runtime role resolves to exactly one validated tensor/view or an explicitly allowed synthesized constant.
implementation_prompt: Specify and implement construction of an immutable tree-runtime ModelHandle from validated loader artifacts. Make ownership, tensor lookup, placement, quant/kernel plan, and source provenance explicit.

objective: Validate compatibility between separately loaded draft and target models before speculative decoding.
mathematical_spec: For draft D and target T require tokenizer compatibility, vocab index compatibility, agreed special-token semantics, and runtime-compatible logits domain. Architecture dimensions may differ unless shared runtime structures require equality. Return per-condition diagnostics.
implementation_prompt: Implement draft-target loader compatibility validation for speculative decoding. Check tokenizer/vocabulary/logit semantics and any shared-runtime invariants, while permitting legitimate model-size and layer-count differences.

objective: Define exact vocabulary remapping when draft and target token IDs differ but token sets are provably equivalent.
mathematical_spec: Given bijection phi:V_D->V_T derived from canonical token bytes/special semantics, require phi be one-to-one and onto over the participating vocabulary. Remapped draft proposal token i becomes phi(i); ambiguous duplicate token representations are incompatible.
implementation_prompt: Implement loader-time construction and validation of an optional draft-to-target token ID remap when exact token equivalence is provable. Reject ambiguous, partial, or semantic special-token mismatches.

objective: Discover and validate auxiliary tree-draft tensors or heads supplied by a model.
mathematical_spec: Define optional tree assets A as canonical roles with shape predicates tied to hidden size, branch count, depth, or vocabulary. Assets are enabled only when the complete required role set for a declared tree-head scheme is present and shape-valid.
implementation_prompt: Implement auxiliary tree-head/tensor discovery using canonical tensor roles and metadata declarations. Validate complete schemes atomically and fall back to ordinary draft execution when optional assets are absent.

objective: Validate attention and KV geometry required by tree decoding kernels.
mathematical_spec: Given H attention heads, H_kv KV heads, head dimension d_h, hidden D, require D=H*d_h and valid head-group relation H/H_kv integer for supported GQA/MQA. Loader exposes canonical kv_head_count and head_dim to runtime.
implementation_prompt: Implement loader-time attention/KV geometry validation and export the canonical values consumed by tree attention and KV-cache components. Include architecture-specific exceptions only when explicitly modeled.

objective: Normalize RoPE and positional-encoding metadata for draft and target runtime contracts.
mathematical_spec: Define positional config P=(type,base,dim,scaling,original_ctx,max_ctx,...). Validate 0<rope_dim<=head_dim where applicable and scaling parameters in their scheme domains. Preserve source defaults versus explicit metadata as provenance.
implementation_prompt: Implement canonical positional-encoding metadata normalization for supported RoPE/scaling schemes and other declared position methods. Reject incomplete scaling configurations and expose explicit/defaulted provenance.

objective: Validate Mixture-of-Experts tensor layouts and quantized expert packing.
mathematical_spec: For E experts and canonical expert matrix role r, descriptors must cover expert indices 0..E-1 exactly or one packed expert axis of length E. Quant group/block layout must not cross expert boundaries unless the encoding explicitly defines such packing.
implementation_prompt: Implement MoE loader validation for separate and packed expert tensors, router tensors, and quantized expert layouts. Produce canonical expert-axis views usable by placement and kernel dispatch.

objective: Validate tied embeddings and output-head aliasing without duplicate materialization.
mathematical_spec: If metadata/config declares tied embeddings, input embedding E and output projection O must be semantically compatible, with O=E or the architecture-defined transpose/view. When one tensor is omitted legally, create an alias view rather than copied bytes.
implementation_prompt: Implement tied-weight validation and zero-copy alias construction for embedding/output-head relationships. Detect contradictory duplicate tensors and preserve source provenance for aliases.

objective: Produce a complete preflight validation report and deterministic fallback plan before runtime activation.
mathematical_spec: Let checks C_i yield PASS, RECOVERABLE(action), or FAIL(error). Activation is allowed iff no FAIL and all RECOVERABLE actions form an acyclic feasible plan within resource/policy constraints. Report ordered checks, chosen actions, and final capabilities.
implementation_prompt: Implement model-load preflight aggregation that runs structural, quantization, placement, tree-runtime, and draft-target checks, computes legal fallback actions, and returns an auditable activation plan without mutating the active runtime.

objective: Define conformance fixtures and validation matrix for all Pilar F loader contracts.
mathematical_spec: Let test matrix dimensions include format, sharding, architecture, dtype/quant type, layout, device capability, valid/corrupt case, and fallback path. Require at least one positive and negative fixture for every parser/adapter contract and cross-format equivalence checks where semantics match.
implementation_prompt: Create the Pilar F conformance specification: fixture taxonomy, golden metadata/tensor descriptors, corruption cases, quant reference comparisons, fallback scenarios, and end-to-end preflight expectations. Keep fixtures minimal and independently attributable to one contract when possible.
